name: queue-summary
title: Queue summary
description: The to-do strip of an admin home: counters for work waiting, each a link to its filtered list, with a 99+ cap, a quiet zero and a text marker for urgent.
docs: Each tile is a link, so pass the filtered list as `href`. Counts above `limit` read 99+ and keep the exact number in the accessible name; a count of zero shows quietly.
